Name: Stalker Qi
Author: stardemod
Description:
[b]Ever feel lonely in Stardew Valley? With this mod, that feeling is gone.[/b] Your favorite backseat gamer, [b]Mr Qi[/b], will relentlessly stalk you across the map. He’s no longer content with watching from afar. Now he actively chases you, navigating around obstacles with real pathfinding.

If Mr Qi catches you, the game immediately ends and returns to the main menu. He’s constantly motivating the player to keep moving. This is perfect for anyone seeking a real challenge in Stardew Valley.

The game is still playable… but don’t spend too much time talking to villagers or farming too quickly. Waiting isn’t one of his strengths.
[b]Mr Qi is always watching… and now he’s coming for you.[/b]

[i]P.S. I considered making this permadeath, but decided against it. Still, I encourage everyone to start a new save if you get caught![/i]
